operations.X: New attributed discussion, assessed against new-request.md.
operations.Y: Revision and compression of published paragraph, assessed against revise-request.md.

scope.comparison_policy: Independent task assessments; no ranking and no inference about an instruction condition.

counting_method: Whitespace-separated body tokens; X heading excluded. Counts check range compliance, not quality.
severity_policy: None means no correction is warranted by supplied evidence; low denotes an optional style change or a record/source verification question. An unresolved question is not a demonstrated error.

assessments.overall_judgment: Meets the substantive new-writing brief. No demonstrated factual or inferential errors. Separate explanatory note cannot be verified from manuscript-only input.

format.attribution: Explicit heading and Högberg (2023) in opening.

dimensions.name: Factual/author fidelity
dimensions.judgment: Claims, numbers and policy direction are faithful.

evidence.text: Belonging coefficient 0.069 and interval [-0.053, 0.241].
Interaction -0.017; smaller slope; small exception among three tested interactions.
Fully adjusted affect associations nonsignificant and cross-sectional.

dimensions.name: Problem and core judgment
dimensions.judgment: Clear contribution: national and individual questions differ; neither a general trade-off nor a general gain is established.

evidence.text: Opening judgment followed by positional-versus-collective distinction.

dimensions.name: Reasoning/evidence organisation
dimensions.judgment: Moves coherently from comparisons through results and an interaction qualification to policy; handles uncertainty correctly.

evidence.text: Within-country fixed effects distinguished from single-wave affect; interval includes both directions.
Interaction qualification precedes recommendation on particular arrangements.

dimensions.limits_or_corrections: Survey names and separate HBSC pupil records would add detail but are not necessary to the requested short discussion.

dimensions.name: Theory/literature use
dimensions.judgment: Uses positional rationale without claiming its mechanism was tested; attribution appropriate.

evidence.text: Individual positional advantage need not become a collective benefit.
Competitive mechanisms remain unmeasured.

dimensions.limits_or_corrections: No independent verification of original cited literature is possible from allowed files.

dimensions.name: Explanation/contribution
dimensions.judgment: Explains levels, outcome differences and proxy limits, then develops a practical implication rather than only restating results.

evidence.text: Assess concrete reforms against both aims and examine outcomes separately; no claim to know which measures work.

dimensions.name: Natural, concrete prose and rhythm
dimensions.judgment: Readable and connected, although the first paragraph is statistically dense.

evidence.text: Several model distinctions and estimates in one paragraph.
Belonging, feelings and stress provide concrete distinctions.

dimensions.name: Author voice
dimensions.judgment: Appropriate third-person secondary voice and fidelity to author's substantive policy agenda.

evidence.text: Secondary-writing heading and named attribution.
Pursue arrangements supporting both aims and respond to harms.

dimensions.limits_or_corrections: Imitation of the original paragraph's wording is not required for this operation.

dimensions.judgment: Qualifications have distinct purposes and do not displace the argument.

evidence.text: Uncertain belonging estimate and cross-sectional affect distinction.
Outcome-specific interaction, unmeasured competition and unevaluated policy measures.

dimensions.limits_or_corrections: No additional generic limitations list is warranted.

dimensions.name: Specific corrections needed from the author
dimensions.judgment: No substantive body correction identified; check the separate note.

evidence.text: Requires a separate explanation of writing choices and author-attention matters.
Exact affect coefficients and some reporting labels are unresolved.

dimensions.limits_or_corrections: If not already delivered, supply a short separate note. X avoids the disputed exact affect coefficients, so no numerical repair is established.

assessments.overall_judgment: Meets the substantive revision brief. Preserves policy position, distinctions and relevant citation while repairing unsupported inference. Separate note and adaptation record cannot be verified.

findings.evidence: X.md contains heading and two discussion paragraphs but no separate explanatory note. The review was restricted to manuscript files.
findings.judgment: Full delivery compliance cannot be determined.
findings.proposed_correction: Verify the separately delivered note; if absent, add a brief explanation of writing choices and relevant source checks.
findings.required_if: The requested note has not been delivered elsewhere.

findings.judgment: Meaning is clear from context, but wording can be more explicit.
findings.proposed_correction: Optionally use 'gains in both achievement and wellbeing'.

findings.evidence: Source pack reports affect coefficient and labelling discrepancies; X uses a qualitative affect summary rather than disputed exact coefficients.
findings.judgment: No numerical error in X is demonstrated and no passage repair is indicated.
findings.proposed_correction: A short note may explain reliance on the verified qualitative summary. Do not require a full audit for this short writing task.

findings.evidence: The manuscript file is only the revised paragraph. The required explanation and adaptation identification may reside in an accompanying record excluded from review.
findings.judgment: Cannot establish that either requirement was omitted from the complete delivery.
findings.proposed_correction: Verify accompanying explanation and explicit adaptation attribution to Högberg (2023); add them separately if absent.
findings.required_if: The required accompanying record is absent or incomplete.

findings.evidence: Moilanen (2010) is retained from the published paragraph, but the cited work is not among supplied sources.
findings.judgment: Retention is faithful and required; the citation's independent support cannot be verified.
findings.proposed_correction: Identify the retained citation as not independently checked in the separate note; verify the original source before asserting independent validation.
findings.required_if: An assertion of independently verified citation support is contemplated.

assessment_limits: Evidence is limited to the supplied source pack and published paragraph; their agreement with the article and supplements was not independently checked.
Original studies cited by Högberg, including Moilanen (2010), were not read.
Statistical analyses and bootstrap intervals were not recomputed.
Separate notes and adaptation records outside the two manuscript files were not read and cannot be judged absent from the full delivery.
Author preferences beyond the supplied material cannot be assessed.
No ranking, instruction-condition inference, keyword quality scores, or mandatory extra caution was used.
